home.license_conditions: use and derivation permitted with attribution; no redistribution
use and derivation permitted with attribution; no redistribution

says: A person installs a supplied knowledge package of tax rate tables into their own scope (source.revision.admit, add_published_package), registers its publisher-owned home with its license conditions and its applicability to jurisdiction KR from tax year 2026 (source.home.register), and sets the package's own rights to read, use and derive, not export (source.rights.set, which moves the source's head). They then extend it: a distinct source admitted through extend_supplied, naming the base source and its exact revision with the installed bytes unmodified, whose provenance is an extension_of_supplied naming that base revision; its own managed home states the base's applicability; its first revision holds only the person's own commentary and declares the base as its companion; and its rights allow read and use, carrying the base's rights by digest. Resolving the extension (reference.resolve) returns its own manifest, the provenance naming the base and its home with the base's conditions. Negatives, each refused and writing nothing: widening the extension's rights to export, which its base does not allow (source_right_not_overridable); deriving from a second package whose rights allow reading alone (source_right_not_overridable: reading never authorizes a derivation); an extension request stating the installed bytes were edited in place, refused at admission; and a commit that overwrites a member of the installed base (publisher_bytes_modified). The publisher's bytes and rights stay as installed.
